name: Yamamori Izumi
source:
Salesperson for a life insurance company.  She lives with her husband and has no children. She's 32 years old.

She has a personality that she can't leave people in trouble alone, and she is very kind to the main character.

[from [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/mama-shibori.html]official site[/url]]
